purpose: Week-3 deterministic missing-fact and bounded clarification development regression
label_provenance: Authored deterministic development labels; labels were not copied from component predictions.
record_requirements: single issue with all facts and with missing required or critical facts
evaluation-only non-critical and stronger assertion-policy profiles
explicit unverified, inferred, unknown, ambiguous, and duplicate fact inputs
no candidate and unsupported candidate fail-closed behavior
previously requested fields, question budget, zero clarification, and legal-conclusion safety
limitations: This is not a frozen v1.1 holdout or release benchmark.
Week 4 owns dataset freezing and human-review completion.
Critical-fact leakage measures gate readiness only; no substantive DecisionRule exists in Week 3.
